definitions.explanation: Spirits of the dead, ghosts, or supernatural phenomena. Used as a modifier to describe things related to the spirit world, hauntings, or psychic experiences.

examples.japanese: {心霊|しんれい}{写真|しゃしん}を{見|み}たことがある。
examples.english: I have seen a ghost photograph.

examples.japanese: あの{建物|たてもの}は{心霊|しんれい}スポットとして{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: That building is famous as a haunted spot.
examples.notes: {心霊|しんれい}スポット is a commonly used term for haunted locations.

examples.japanese: {心霊|しんれい}{現象|げんしょう}を{科学的|かがくてき}に{解明|かいめい}しようとする{研究者|けんきゅうしゃ}もいる。
examples.english: There are researchers who try to explain psychic phenomena scientifically.

notes:
{心霊|しんれい} refers to spirits, ghosts, or psychic phenomena. It is most commonly used as a modifier (の-adjective) in compound terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {心霊|しんれい}{写真|しゃしん}: ghost photograph
- {心霊|しんれい}スポット: haunted spot
- {心霊|しんれい}{現象|げんしょう}: psychic/supernatural phenomena
- {心霊|しんれい}{体験|たいけん}: supernatural experience
- {心霊|しんれい}{番組|ばんぐみ}: ghost/supernatural TV show

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {幽霊|ゆうれい}: ghost, apparition (a specific spirit)
- {亡霊|ぼうれい}: ghost of the dead
- {怨霊|おんりょう}: vengeful spirit
- {霊|れい}: spirit, soul (broader term)
